motion_summary: Fresh complete-route qualification: reference 1/4, recovery candidate 2/4. The matched recovery component had 29.1% lower measured arm jerk with 11.7% more time. In the only mutually qualified fresh pair, the candidate used 9 additional steps and took 5.87 seconds longer. No complete-route efficiency gain was demonstrated. GMR walking and turning results were mixed. Native gait weights stayed fixed; zero new optimizer updates.

confound: Initial adapter clipped native actuator commands even with no reference blend. These attempts are retained, excluded from efficacy claims and followed by corrected runs and an exact zero-blend control.
causal_limits: Duration and mink IK were changed together; no solver-only benefit is identified.
GMR calibration and native-cycle indexing are unvalidated prototypes; these results do not evaluate a trained imitation controller.
Four fresh cases in one simulated layout cannot establish broad robustness or hardware transfer.

gmr-walking-reference-calibrated.json.source: CMU Graphics Lab recording 07_01, Bruce Hahne BVH conversion
gmr-walking-reference-calibrated.json.calibration_scope: CMU neutral bone basis and per-landmark scale calibrated to the G1 T-pose. Unadapted LaFAN mapping retained as a rejected kinematic diagnostic.
gmr-walking-reference-calibrated.json.scope: Kinematic reference generation only. Root references are never assigned to the physical executor. No optimizer updates or claim of physical improvement.

gmr-unadapted-cmu-reference.json.source: CMU Graphics Lab recording 07_01, Bruce Hahne BVH conversion
gmr-unadapted-cmu-reference.json.scope: Kinematic reference generation only. Root references are never assigned to the physical executor. No optimizer updates or claim of physical improvement.

reference_environment.scope: Actual core GMR retargeting and actual mink IK. No new neural optimizer updates. No GMR floating-base replay into physics.

asset_delivery.scope: Visual materials, UVs and mesh compression. No geometry simplification, physical model or trajectory change.

arm_measurement_data.scope: Unrounded measured arm joint positions and timestamps for every component and each full-route recovery phase. Recompute finite differences with visual_motion_v22/metrics.py. These are measured joint states, not desired controls.

assessment.uncertainty_scope: Four cases from one simulated desk layout. These descriptive binomial intervals do not establish broad environment or hardware generalization.
